title: Pokémon Y
tested: New game in German from the language screen through the professor's talk, the name entry on the touch screen and the bedroom scene; walking around the room, the X menu, saving, and after a restart Continue from that save. Not tested: anything after the bedroom (no battle, no outdoor area), long sessions. Also on a low-budget machine (Batocera Linux mini PC, AMD Ryzen 3 PRO 4350GE, Radeon Vega 6): the same new-game route and the Continue route, started from the system's menu, with a photo of the screen checked for each; 60 shown / 30 game pictures a second once the shaders of a scene are cached. The first time a scene is shown its shaders are compiled, which drops the game to as low as 8 to 20 pictures a second for up to a minute (measured in Pokémon X's opening); the cache is kept.
